title: Our store must be agent-ready as AI takes over discovery
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery (NIQ). Global PC shipments fell 21% in Q3 (Counterpoint), with a 27% Q4 drop forecast. Walmart opened to outside AI agents with spending limits; Amazon blocks them. Walmart stretched Black Friday to 14 days.

points.headline: AI is now a mainstream discovery channel and retailers are setting agent rules
points.detail: 55% of consumers use AI in discovery (NIQ). Walmart admits outside agents with profiles and spending controls while Amazon blocks them. We should decide how agents read and buy from our store.

points.headline: PC demand is falling sharply into Q4
points.detail: Global PC shipments dropped 21% in Q3 and Q4 is forecast down 27% (Counterpoint). We should plan promotions, pricing and inventory for a much weaker market.

points.headline: Memory costs push up prices and make financing more attractive
points.detail: Memory costs lifted the iPad mini price and IDC surveys buyers on financing amid shortage fears. We should test leasing and instalment offers for business buyers.

points.headline: Walmart stretches its Black Friday and Cyber Monday window to 14 days
points.detail: The event grows from 10 to 14 days, which may pull electronics demand earlier. We should check our deal calendar and price matching against it.
